provenance.notes: Generic experimental RC blimp. Geometry is measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope; every physical input below is a documented engineering estimate or design choice, not a measurement of a real aircraft. Positions are anchors resolved by build_data.py against assets/aircraft/rc-blimp-5m/geometry.json.

length.source: Envelope length (5.0 m by definition); geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

max_diameter.source: Maximum envelope diameter; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

volume.source: Closed envelope volume; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

centroid.source: Envelope volume centroid (centre of buoyancy); geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

surface_area.source: Envelope surface area; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

areal_mass.source: TPU-laminated 40-70 g/m^2 nylon plus seams, valves and fin mounts, typical outdoor 5 m RC envelopes; estimate

radius_profile.source: Equivalent radius sqrt(A/pi) of envelope cross-sections; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

density.source: Helium at 20 C, 101.325 kPa, dry (ideal gas, M = 4.0026 g/mol); purity assumed 100 %

fill_fraction.source: Taut constant-volume envelope at reference pressure (plan BL-02, short-flight constant-fill approximation)

axial_drag_coefficient.source: Volume-referenced bare-hull drag of streamlined airship hulls at Re 0.2-1e6 (Hoerner 1965 ch. 6; Khoury 2012 ch. 5), plus seam roughness

crossflow_drag_coefficient.source: Subcritical circular-cylinder crossflow drag coefficient (Allen and Perkins 1951; Jones and DeLaurier 1983)

crossflow_efficiency.source: Finite-length crossflow efficiency for L/D 5 bodies (Allen and Perkins 1951 eta ~0.6)

afterbody_loss_factor.source: Hopkins 1951 (NACA RM A51C14): slender-body potential normal force vanishes aft of the station of steepest area decrease; full cancellation of the afterbody potential load in forward flight

linear_damping_force.source: Small low-speed viscous floor so quadratic laws do not leave undamped creep; below 1 % of quadratic drag at 1 m/s

linear_damping_moment.source: Low-rate skin-friction floor for rotation; estimate

fin_normal_coefficient.source: Strip-theory flat-plate added mass rho*pi*(c/2)^2 per span (Newman 1977, Marine Hydrodynamics, sec. 4.13)

hull_scale.source: Lamb 1932 sec. 373 prolate-spheroid coefficients for the volume-equivalent spheroid of the measured length; shape difference retained as uncertainty

area_fixed.source: Fin dorsal fixed planform; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

area_moving.source: Fin dorsal moving planform; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

centroid.source: Fin dorsal planform centroid; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

normal.source: Fin dorsal plane normal; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

span.source: Fin dorsal span; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

mean_chord.source: Fin dorsal mean chord; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

te_sign.source: Sign of the trailing-edge displacement along the normal for +CTRL (geometry te_dir_at_plus_10deg)

travel.source: Model rig limit CTRL Aleta timon +-20 deg (delivery; documented EASA AS.001 LZ N07 reference)

servo_response_time.source: Standard 9 g digital servo with linkage, first-order approximation

servo_max_rate.source: 0.12 s/60 deg micro servo at 5 V, derated for load

crossflow_drag_coefficient.source: Normal flat-plate drag of low aspect ratio (Hoerner 1965 ch. 3)

rotation_sense.source: Design: 2212-class 1000 kV outrunners on 3S with 7x4 (side, stern) and 6x3 reversible (lateral) props sized to the scaled 2.7/2.2 m full-scale diameters. Static thrust from momentum theory with figure of merit 0.6 at the stated shaft power; pitch speed = rpm x geometric pitch x 0.9; torque ratio Q/T ~ 0.065 D; reverse efficiency of a reversed fixed-pitch prop ~0.7; first-order spool-up 0.12-0.14 s. Estimates, not bench measurements (BL-T02 open).

hull_points.source: Envelope, fin and gondola collision witnesses; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

prop_points.source: Propeller disc extremes at vector 0; geometry.json measured from the owner's model scaled to a 5.0 m envelope

hull_stiffness.source: Inflated fabric local stiffness per contact point (pressurised 300-400 Pa)

impact_speed_limit.source: Experimental terminal threshold for an envelope strike; not a damage model

differential_thrust.source: Aileron stick trims side thrust +-35 % of the throttle for yaw

vector_on_pitch.source: Full back stick reaches the full 120 deg side travel (braking/hover past vertical)

lateral_on_yaw.source: Rudder stick drives the reversible stern thruster, coupled to the rudders as on the reference airship

stern_vector_on_pitch.source: +1: stern thrust at full vector points down (back stick, nose up); -1: up (forward stick, nose down)

presentation.frame: GLB in Godot axes (nose -Z, right +X, up +Y), origin = physics datum O
